_what: The Japan profile layer (plan 10, commitment C-7, card 10C-25, D-1250): the one description of what a site in Japan gets. The site's country (JP: tb_common.derived.country_of, the same reading the site profile is checked against, D-1233) turns it on; every behaviour reads its part here (tb_common.country_layer). Parts P1 to P16 are review 11 section 8's. A part 'declared, not built' carries no values: the card that builds it adds them here. Each rule and source is the project's reading of the public text named, to be confirmed by the first site's trial office; what is recorded here is not the complete set of a site's requirements (see 'elsewhere').

P1.name: Legal pack
P1.not_built: the 利用目的 line, the 指針 2026 opt-out template, the study-kind memo, the PPC leak path (10C-2, waits for decision 21); the access rule is proposed to lane C2 (10C-3, D-1238)

P2.name: Study kinds
P2.not_built: each kind's words (10C-6), forms (10C-17) and registry (10C-21)

P3.name: Committees

chiken.source: GCP省令 (平成9年厚生省令第28号) 第27条 (the IRB), 第32条 (its review): the IRB's opinion before the trial. Article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not re-verified
chiken.elsewhere: Also needed, not recorded here (the site's own): the trial contract (GCP省令 第13条). To be confirmed by the site's trial office
chiken.permission_is: 実施医療機関の長の指示・決定 (the head of the institution's decision after the IRB), GCP省令 第27条, 統一書式5

tokutei.source: 臨床研究法 (平成29年法律第16号) 第5条 (実施計画 with the CRB's opinion), 第23条 (certified committees). Article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not re-verified
tokutei.elsewhere: Also needed, not recorded here (the site's own): the 実施計画 submitted to the Minister and published in jRCT (臨床研究法 第5条). To be confirmed by the site's trial office
tokutei.permission_is: 実施医療機関の管理者の承認 (the administrator's approval after the CRB), 臨床研究法施行規則

shishin.source: 人を対象とする生命科学・医学系研究に関する倫理指針 第6 (研究計画書に関する手続): the 研究機関の長's permission after the 倫理審査委員会's review; 一括審査 for multicentre research (article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not verified against the 2026 consolidated text)
shishin.elsewhere: Not recorded here: an external ethics committee is not always under a contract (the 指針 asks for the committee's procedures, not a contract); the no_contract warning is the project's reading. To be confirmed by the site's trial office
shishin.permission_is: 研究機関の長の許可 (実施許可, the head of the research institution's permission after the ethics committee), 生命・医学系指針 第6

open_questions: Does the head-of-institution permission apply to all three Japanese study kinds? The layer keeps today's 'needs' (both records for every kind, the lane J lead's ruling of 2026-11-19).
Is a running study stopped when the Japan rule arrives? The layer keeps today's behaviour: a study open before the rule is marked before_rule and not held for a kind not chosen (D-1227).

P4.name: Roles
P4.not_built: 治験事務局, 記録保存責任者, the CRC's employer: lane C2 decides (10C-16)

P5.name: Words
P5.everywhere: On everywhere, not switched by country: the Japanese device-claims rule (D-1228) is a lint over the project's own Japanese texts, by their language
P5.not_built: the term set per study kind and the 治験参加者 switch (10C-6), the polite register (10C-7)

P7.name: Masters
P7.everywhere: On everywhere, not switched by country: the licensed MEDIS, JLAC10 and YJ releases are read from the terminology store (D-137) wherever a site loads them

P8.name: Chart reading
P8.not_built: one ja cue table (10A-10), the abbreviation table (10C-11), the 保険病名 flag (10C-10), suspected-is-not-present by default (10C-12), the older-records boundary (10C-22), note sections (10C-23)

P10.name: Privacy guard
P10.everywhere: On everywhere, not switched by country: the guard's Japanese rules (10C-1) are keyed by the characters of the text and run at every site

P11.name: Patient approach
P11.not_built: approach outcomes (10C-18), letters through the 主治医 (10C-8)
open_questions: What does a missing assent do? The layer keeps today's behaviour: a minor's record without assent warns (D-1232).

P12.name: Money
P12.not_built: 負担軽減費 per visit and the 医事課 list: no card in plan 10

P16.name: Accessibility and type
P16.everywhere: On everywhere, not switched by country: the CJK layout rules apply to every page in ja, by its language

_ruling: Each kind needs both records to open: the committee's approval and the site's head-of-institution record (permission_is). The lane J lead's ruling of 2026-11-19, following the card, until the owner says otherwise: to change it, edit parts.P3.values.committees 'needs' (one line per kind).
